method.coordinate_order: Original reported longitude, latitude; no coordinate is modified.
method.algorithm: Even-odd Polygon/MultiPolygon containment with holes; per-polygon bounding boxes and one-degree latitude-band edge index.
method.boundary: Any exterior/hole edge (including coasts), or interiors of more than one region, yields boundary. No first-match country wins.
method.outside: No land polygon contains the reported point. This can include sea, lakes, generalized coasts/islands or uncovered areas; not a verified marine or territorial classification.
method.tolerance_scope: Computational roundoff only, not positional uncertainty, a coastline buffer or a nearest-country assignment.
method.antimeridian: Ring/query longitudes are unwrapped only inside containment calculations. Original positive Aleutian longitudes remain unchanged.
method.region_ids: Unique three-uppercase-letter source ISO_A3 where present; otherwise NE_ plus ASCII ADMIN slug (never -99).
method.limitations: Generalized map geometry and de facto boundary policy, not authoritative jurisdiction, nationality, EEZ, uncertainty propagation, or a tectonic classification.

text.en: Approximate country/territory by reported point inside Natural Earth land polygons. Unassigned sea/coast/boundary cases remain separate; provider and locality text are not used.
text.es: País/territorio aproximado por el punto reportado dentro de polígonos terrestres Natural Earth. Mar/costa sin asignación y límites quedan separados; no se usa el proveedor ni el texto de localidad.
